ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO.
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1 - 2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications
as shown on Map No. 7-N in the area bounded by
The public alley next north of and parallel to West Diversey Avenue ; North New England

Avenue; West Diversey Avenue; and a line 75 feet west of and parallel to North New
England Avenue

to those of a B3 — 2 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common address of the property: 6902 W. Diversey Ave., Chicago IL
